import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/services/nlnet-csv-milestone')
station_path = root / 'station-csv-acceptance.json'
suite_path = root / 'suite-evidence.json'
station = json.loads(station_path.read_text())
suite = json.loads(suite_path.read_text())
cases = station['cases']
assert station['all_pass'] is True and all(case['passed'] is True for case in cases.values())
assert cases['clean']['issues'] == []
assert any(issue['kind'] == 'missing_required_column' and issue['header'] == 'reading' for issue in cases['missing_required_column']['issues'])
assert any(issue['kind'] == 'column_count' and issue['record'] == 2 and issue['expected'] == 2 and issue['actual'] == 3 for issue in cases['extra_field']['issues'])
assert suite['exit_code'] == 0 and 'passed 10/10' in suite['stdout']

brief = {
    'public_benefit': 'Help public-data publishers detect malformed station CSV files before people or software consume them.',
    'proposed_deliverables': ['Document an offline invocation and its input limits', 'Package fictional clean, missing-header and extra-field examples with expected diagnostics', 'Provide a reproducible acceptance command for maintainers'],
    'acceptance': {'existing_regression_suite': suite['stdout'].strip(), 'station_controls': cases},
    'receipt_sha256': {str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in (station_path, suite_path)},
    'status': 'Technical milestone draft grounded in committed offline receipts. Applicant eligibility, licensing commitments, application, award and settlement require separate evidence.'
}
result = root / 'technical-milestone-brief.json'
result.write_text(json.dumps(brief, indent=2) + '\n')
assert json.loads(result.read_text()) == brief
print(result)

description: The NLnet CSV baseline passed 10 of 10 checks, and all three station CSV acceptance controls passed. The follow-up stopped on a missing `issues` key. Reuse the committed controls and read each case’s nested diagnostics to preserve a reproducible milestone brief. Application depends on first-party evidence that the intended applicant can take responsibility for the disclosed autonomous AI work. The catalogue rehearsal can close independently once its bilingual replies match the executed controls.
